title: Notch signaling mediated repressive effects of resveratrol in inducing caspasedependent apoptosis in MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
authors: Pandey, Pratibha; Ramniwas, Seema; Seifeldin, Sara A; Alshaghdali, Khalid; Alharazi, Talal; Acar, Tolgahan; Upadhye, Vijay Jagdish; Sharma, Nishesh; Khan, Fahad; Saeed, Amir
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇通过Notch信号通路诱导乳腺癌细胞凋亡，仅含小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Resveratrol, a potent anticancer bioactive compound, has been shown to trigger apoptosis in numerous cancer cells. Although Notch signaling promotes breast cancer apoptosis, it is unclear whether resveratrol induces apoptosis in MCF-7 cells via influencing the Notch pathway. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of resveratrol on modulating Notch signaling targets and provide critical information for employing resveratrol in breast cancer therapy. Thus, in this study, we have deciphered the effect of resveratrol against three potent genes (Notch1, Jagged1, and DLL4) of the notch signaling pathway. For mechanistic studies, in silico, and in vitro analysis was executed to investigate the apoptotic-inducing potential of resveratrol against three selected oncogenes involved in the progression of breast cancer. Docking analysis revealed the inhibitory potential of resveratrol against all three selected targets of the Notch pathway (Notch1: -5.0; Jagged-1: -5.9; DLL4: -5.8). In vitro, findings further displayed a significant reduction in cell viability in resveratrol-treated MCF-7 cancer cells, which were concomitantly related to the downregulation of Notch-1, Jagged-1, and DLL4. Moreover, the antiproliferative efficacy of resveratrol was correlated with apoptosis and modulation in the expression of Bax, Bcl-2, cyclin D1, CDK4, p21, and caspase-3 activation. Taken together, these experimental findings suggested that apoptotic inducing potential of resveratrol was mediated through a novel mechanism involving suppression of the Notch signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 白藜芦醇（resveratrol）作为一种强效抗癌生物活性化合物，已被证明能在多种癌细胞中触发凋亡。尽管Notch信号传导促进乳腺癌细胞凋亡，但尚不清楚白藜芦醇是否通过影响Notch通路诱导MCF-7细胞凋亡。本研究旨在评估白藜芦醇对调节Notch信号靶点的作用，并为将白藜芦醇应用于乳腺癌治疗提供关键信息。因此，在本研究中，我们解析了白藜芦醇对Notch信号通路中三个强效基因（Notch1、Jagged1和DLL4）的影响。为进行机制研究，我们实施了计算机模拟（in silico）和体外（in vitro）分析，以探究白藜芦醇针对参与乳腺癌进展的三个选定癌基因的凋亡诱导潜力。对接分析揭示了白藜芦醇对Notch通路所有三个选定靶点的抑制潜力（Notch1：-5.0；Jagged-1：-5.9；DLL4：-5.8）。体外研究结果进一步显示，在白藜芦醇处理的MCF-7癌细胞中，细胞活力显著降低，这与Notch-1、Jagged-1和DLL4的下调密切相关。此外，白藜芦醇的抗增殖功效与凋亡及Bax、Bcl-2、cyclin D1、CDK4、p21表达调节和caspase-3激活相关。综合来看，这些实验发现表明，白藜芦醇的凋亡诱导潜力是通过一种涉及抑制Notch信号通路的新机制介导的。
